name: Bite Me
source:
The party you attended has turned deadly, and now you must seduce vampires to stay alive… but you’re also becoming one of them.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你出席的派对骤然化作致命杀局，如今你必须魅惑身边的吸血鬼才能保住性命……然而与此同时，你自己也正一步步变成他们的同类。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
